note: Planning manifest with any locally imported GeoJSON footprints and unverified ray paths. This manifest does not attest to a local Sionna-RT job. No real network connection, scheduled task dispatch, hardware discovery, software installation, telemetry collection, A/B run, drive measurement, or dataset generation was performed.

exampleProvenance.measurements: All KPI values, events, times and serving-sector assignments are synthetic examples; not measured SKT performance or ray-tracing output.
exampleProvenance.radioSites: Only horizontal site positions, station names, addresses, operator, permit IDs and registered 5G service come from KCA public radio-station records. Registry positions may differ from current field conditions.
exampleProvenance.rfConfiguration: Required height (30 m) and three-sector radio parameters are demonstration assumptions. SITE IDs are internal identifiers, not gNB/eNB IDs. Nearest selected station assigns a synthetic serving cell, not a real coverage relationship.
exampleProvenance.streetGeometry: OSRM route using OpenStreetMap road geometry. Sample GPS coordinates are interpolated on that route. This is a sample loop, not an optimized measurement campaign.
